answer_2.quote: We report three key factual evaluation metrics: (i) Precision measures the proportion of correct facts among all extracted facts. (ii) Recall assesses the proportion of reference facts that are covered by the model response, and (iii) F1 balances precision and recall.

answer_3.quote: To automate the detection of incomplete and missing facts, we employ three LLMs (GPT-4o, Llama 3.3-70B, Qwen 2.5-32B) to replicate the annotation process followed by human annotators.
methods: LLM-based automatic labeling of incomplete and missing facts via prompting

answer_4.quote: We employ four annotators, all fluent English speakers with relevant research experience in fact-checking, to identify incomplete and missing facts from all 451 extracted facts, with each fact independently annotated by all four.
answer_4.guideline: Annotation guidelines and merging procedure are described in Appendix A.3.
